summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high liver risk score of 75 and a low heart risk score of 42 for Ranitidine Bismuth Citrate [M]. Out of 10 total clinical trials, examples of stopped studies include one ended for reasons unrelated to safety and another stopped because of slow patient recruitment [4][5]. A third trial was ended while waiting on data analysis [6].
